brief:
Israel's National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir entered Al-Aqsa Mosque in occupied Jerusalem on Monday, according to Shehab Wire. He was accompanied by police protection and a group of settlers. Ben Gvir performed prayers in the eastern section of the mosque during the visit.

The incursion represents a significant violation of the compound's longstanding status as a Muslim holy site. Under agreements governing access to Al-Aqsa, non-Muslim worship at the mosque is prohibited. Such entries by Israeli officials and settlers have fueled tensions over control and religious practices at the contested Jerusalem location, one of Islam's holiest sites.
